note: کوئری‌های تعیین‌تکلیفِ سه آزمایشِ باز در ۱۱ مهر ۱۴۰۵ (۳ اکتبر ۲۰۲۶). همه فقط عددِ تجمیعی می‌دهند، پس db-queryِ ساده کافی است. reading_model_ds با Q1/Q2ِ بی‌تغییرِ reading-model-ds.json (کلیدهای eval و cost_scenarios) خوانده شد.
howToRun: Ops (ops.yml روی main): action=db-query، app=tarot، only=bot-fa.db، query=<متنِ یک‌خطیِ هر کلید>. خروجی بعد از خطِ «===== db-query روی tarot/data/bot-fa.db =====». پنجره هر بار تا «اکنون» است، پس اجرای دوباره عددِ تازه می‌دهد.
perf: اجرای واقعی ۱۱ مهر ۱۴۰۵: هر سه زیرِ سقفِ ۳۰۰ ثانیه (ref_block حدودِ ۱۶ ثانیه). روی دیتابیسِ ساختگیِ هم‌شکل با EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN چک شدند؛ هیچ SCANِ جدولِ بزرگ داخلِ حلقه نیست (llm_usage و events با CTEِ MATERIALIZED و بازه‌ی زمانی محدود).

ref_block.sql: WITH nw AS (SELECT CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) t), ex AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT experiment_key ek, user_id uid, variant arm, created_at xt FROM ab_exposures WHERE experiment_key IN ('reading_model_ds','chat_rollout_b','price_ladder_p5_basic_20') AND user_id NOT IN (429557996,409581917,100257975,5725984933) ), rf AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT referrer_id, created_at, rewarded FROM referrals WHERE created_at >= 1789758624), ri AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT ex.ek, ex.uid, COUNT(*) n, SUM(rf.rewarded) nok, SUM(rf.created_at < ex.xt + 604800) n7, SUM(rf.created_at < ex.xt + 604800 AND rf.rewarded = 1) nok7 FROM ex JOIN rf ON rf.referrer_id = ex.uid AND rf.created_at >= ex.xt GROUP BY ex.ek, ex.uid ), dsx AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT uid, xt FROM ex WHERE ek = 'reading_model_ds'), kk AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT x.uid, MIN(e.created_at) kt FROM dsx x JOIN events e ON e.user_id = x.uid AND e.created_at >= x.xt AND e.created_at >= 1789845024 AND e.created_at < (SELECT t FROM nw) WHERE e.event = 'act' AND json_extract(e.props,'$.a') = 'my_chat_member' AND json_extract(e.props,'$.d') = 'kicked' GROUP BY x.uid ), xu AS ( SELECT ex.ek, ex.arm, ex.uid, ex.xt, COALESCE(ri.n,0) n, COALESCE(ri.nok,0) nok, COALESCE(ri.n7,0) n7, COALESCE(ri.nok7,0) nok7, CASE WHEN ex.ek = 'reading_model_ds' THEN kk.kt END kt FROM ex LEFT JOIN ri ON ri.ek = ex.ek AND ri.uid = ex.uid LEFT JOIN kk ON kk.uid = ex.uid ) SELECT ek AS k, arm, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(n > 0) AS inviters, SUM(n) AS invites, SUM(nok > 0) AS inviters_ok, SUM(nok) AS invites_ok, SUM(xt <= (SELECT t FROM nw) - 604800) AS elig7, SUM(xt <= (SELECT t FROM nw) - 604800 AND n7 > 0) AS inviters7, SUM(CASE WHEN xt <= (SELECT t FROM nw) - 604800 THEN n7 ELSE 0 END) AS invites7, SUM(CASE WHEN xt <= (SELECT t FROM nw) - 604800 THEN nok7 ELSE 0 END) AS invites_ok7, SUM(kt IS NOT NULL) AS blocked, SUM(xt <= (SELECT t FROM nw) - 604800 AND kt IS NOT NULL AND kt < xt + 604800) AS blocked7 FROM xu GROUP BY ek, arm
